name: venture-blueprint-team
description: A venture blueprint team for emerging niche tracks: track deconstruction, business model design, unit economics, landing simulation, and AI-governance risk audit, delivering an actionable business plan.

displayDescription.en: Deconstruct emerging niche tracks, design landable models, and stress-test unit economics, rollout paths and AI-governance risk.
displayDescription.zh: 拆解新兴细分赛道，设计可落地商业模式，完成单位经济测算、落地推演与AI治理审计。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我拆解一个新兴细分赛道：判断价值窗口与进入时机，并给出可落地的商业模式假设
defaultInitPrompt.en: Deconstruct an emerging niche track for me: judge the value window and entry timing, then propose landable business model hypotheses.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我拆解一个新兴细分赛道：判断价值窗口与进入时机，并给出可落地的商业模式假设
quickPrompts.en: Deconstruct an emerging niche track for me: judge the value window and entry timing, then propose landable business model hypotheses.

quickPrompts.zh: 基于我的资源与能力清单，设计商业模式与单位经济模型，并给出90天最小验证路径
quickPrompts.en: Based on my resources and capabilities, design the business model and unit economics, plus a 90-day minimum validation path.

quickPrompts.zh: 对我现有的商业策划案做落地推演与风险审计，重点检查AI使用安全、数据合规与失败预案
quickPrompts.en: Run a landing simulation and risk audit on my business plan, focusing on AI usage safety, data compliance and failure contingencies.
